title: nfl.ingest.v1 - pointer envelope a producer ships to NFL inside a Packet Constitution v1 packet
description: Carried as payload/nfl.ingest.json of a packet that CPR verifies (Packet Constitution v1 Option A). NFL commits commit_hash to its ledger under artifact 'nfl.ingest.v1:<producer>:<packet_id>' where packet_id is the CPR-verified id (SHA-256 of manifest.json) and answers with an nfl.receipt.v1. The envelope's own packet_id is the producer's declared id: under Option A the manifest covers this file, so it cannot equal the real packet id; NFL records it as declared_packet_id and never relies on it. NFL never stores the payload; payload_ref is a pointer. Authoritative copy of the schema the producers (runledger, rebound, ...) already carry.

packet_id.description: Producer-declared packet id (see description). Not verified by NFL.

producer.description: Registered service id of the producer; producer>nfl must be a registered integration.
